svg.text: Orvanna data model: schema app, the public views, and the payment status machine
Supabase Postgres project oiyibdczkokegaxkwulv. Every table lives in schema app. The browser reads only the seven public v_demo_ views.
1. The engine schema: who is in the tree, what they bought, what they were paid
COMMISSION ENGINE (one frozen snapshot per monthly run)
id, sku, name, tier (domain or support),
id, period, spec_version, status (running, final, superseded),
started_at, finished_at, notes, total_sv, total_cv, total_payout, members_paid
one row per ancestor and descendant pair, to full depth
run_id, member_id, sv, cv, tv, is_active, rank_earned,
id, run_id, earner_id, source_member_id, level (1 to 5),
rank_code, rank_name, sort_order, paid_depth (member 1 to executive 5)
completed orders are what the engine aggregates into Sales Volume
2. The live demonstration checkout: written only by Edge Functions, read by no view
all money in integer cents, pv_total, payment_reference,
payment_status, processor_summary, six tax provenance columns
member_id, read only attribution: it feeds nothing in the commission engine
3. The entire public read surface: seven views in schema public, SELECT only, final runs only
No view exposes an email address or an internal id. Views are definer views owned by the read only role app_demo_reader. Row Level Security is on for every table,
and no policy exists for the anon or authenticated roles, so the published key can read nothing from a table even if a view were dropped.
4. app.demo_orders.payment_status: the legal moves, enforced by a database trigger
Trigger app.demo_orders_guard_status_transition, before update of payment_status (migration 010). Setting the same status again is always allowed, so retries are harmless.
terminal, retry is a NEW order
an immediate approval, no challenge needed
never reached the processor, swept after one hour
Dashed: a late truth. The processor webhook, or a later retrieve, can still settle an abandoned row, because abandonment is our
guess about a shopper and never the processor's word about the money.
Forbidden, and refused with an exception
a settled receipt cannot be rewritten
a retry is a new order number, not an edit
an abandoned order may only resolve, never restart
created is an initial state only, so no row can rewind
Two more locks, in the function layer
1. Status is only ever written from a fresh retrieve against the
processor, never from anything the browser says.
2. The update carries its own guard list, so a row that settled
between the retrieve and the write is left alone.
